title: Dread Warren round 6: mineshaft, river bank, winding hall and the scream again
desc: J rated v2.0111 (KEEP W1b6 "Great idea" and W3c1b3b). Three new versions of each IMPROVE: the old mineshaft and the river bank entrances, the winding hall (webs only on the walls: "THE WEBBING ON THE INSIDE SHOULDNTBE HERE"), and four Lights out scream takes, with the construct spider's eyes big and bright ("Cant see boss spiders eyes as well"). Entrance and hall clips run CALM 3 s, then DANGER.

takes.name: Mineshaft: clear mouth, lantern inside
takes.facts: from W1a5; the gravel gone so the mouth is clear, an old lantern still hanging in the first frame (the lure); from eye height where you'd stand. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open, a Hunter comes out
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a5a Mineshaft: clear mouth, lantern inside

takes.name: Mineshaft: rails and a cart
takes.facts: from W1a5; the rails run out of the mine toward you and an old minecart sits on them, as if someone just left; from eye height where you'd stand. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open, a Hunter comes out
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a5b Mineshaft: rails and a cart

takes.name: Mineshaft: fallen-in roof
takes.facts: from W1a5; the hill has fallen in over the first frames, a broken beam leaning across the mouth, moonlight inside; from eye height where you'd stand. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open, a Hunter comes out
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a5c Mineshaft: fallen-in roof

takes.name: River bank: taller gap, stepping stones
takes.facts: from W1a6; the gap under the bank a block taller and stepping stones leading across the water to it; from eye height where you'd stand. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open, a Hunter comes out
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a6a River bank: taller gap, stepping stones

takes.name: River bank: behind a little waterfall
takes.facts: from W1a6; a thin waterfall pours off the bank over the gap, hiding it like a curtain; from eye height where you'd stand. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open, a Hunter comes out
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a6b River bank: behind a little waterfall

takes.name: River bank: fallen log
takes.facts: from W1a6; a fallen log bridges the river right to the gap, fewer reeds; from eye height where you'd stand. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open, a Hunter comes out
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a6c River bank: fallen log

takes.name: Winding hall: warmer, webs on the walls
takes.facts: from W1b5; your ring dimmed so the walls aren't green, warm light deeper in; the webs light up on the walls and in the roof only, never across your path; from inside, standing where you would, your ring the only lamp. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open in the burrows
takes.cam3p: Cam W1b5a Winding hall: warmer, webs on the walls

takes.name: Winding hall: burrows glowing
takes.facts: from W1b5; in danger every burrow glows warm from inside, eyes in each; webs on the walls only; from inside, standing where you would, your ring the only lamp. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open in the burrows

takes.name: Winding hall: narrow and tall

takes.cam3p: Cam W1b5c Winding hall: narrow and tall
